pairs.target: dù chéng zhè huílái zhǎo tǎ wéi , méi xiānjiè dèngzǐ , xiān wèn tā chī wán méiyǒu . tǎ wéi shuō hái shèng bànwǎn , dù chéng biàn lì zài ménbiān děng , jí dé yìzhī jiǎo bùtíng diǎn dì . shàng huí chàng dé tàiwǎn , jīnwǎn tízǎo kāi , piānpiān qiāo gǔ de rén hái zài tìrén bǔxié , shǎo gèrén qù bǎ tā cóng pù lǐ jiào chūlái .
pairs.english: This time Du Cheng came not to borrow a bench, but to ask if Tavi had eaten. Half a bowl left, Tavi said; Du Cheng waited by the door, one foot impatiently tapping. After last time's late singing, tonight they'd start early, but the drummer was still mending shoes. Someone had to fetch him.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄这回来找塔维，没先借凳子，先问他吃完没有。塔维说还剩半碗，杜澄便立在门边等，急得一只脚不停点地。上回唱得太晚，今晚提早开，偏偏敲鼓的人还在替人补鞋，少个人去把他从铺里叫出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi duānwǎn hēwán , gēn tā wǎng shānyāo zǒu . guò bǔxié pù shí , gǔshǒu zhèng hán zhe yìgēn xì dīng zhǎo chuí , jiàn liǎng rén zhàn zài ménkǒu , jìng jiāng jiǎo shàng de xié táiqǐ lái , shìyì zìjǐ yě hái méi nòng hǎo . dù chéng yìbǎ ná guò gǔ , búràng tā zài ná xié dāng jièkǒu . nà rén zhǐhǎo dānjiǎotiào le liǎngxià , jiāng xiéhòugēn cǎi píng chuān shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi finished his bowl and followed uphill. At the shoe shop the drummer searched for a hammer with a little nail between his lips. Seeing them, he lifted his own shoe to show it wasn't finished either. Du Cheng seized the drum, refusing to let shoes excuse him again; the man hopped twice and trod down his shoe's heel to put it on.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维端碗喝完，跟他往山腰走。过补鞋铺时，鼓手正含着一根细钉找锤，见两人站在门口，竟将脚上的鞋抬起来，示意自己也还没弄好。杜澄一把拿过鼓，不让他再拿鞋当借口。那人只好单脚跳了两下，将鞋后跟踩平穿上。

pairs.target: xiǎo tīng de bù shān yǐjīng guà hǎo , lǎofù zhàn zài chuāng biān , tóng shàng huí qiāo chuāng de nánrén shuōhuà . tā jīnrì réng yào zǎoshuì , què bào zhe háizi láikàn yíhuìer , tèdì xuǎn le zuì kào mén de wèizhì . háizi bùkěn zuò , jiū zhe tā yījiǎo wǎng bù shān hòumiàn wàng , xiǎnrán nà dào shānmén bǐ yào chàng de qǔzi gèng yǒuyìsī .
pairs.english: The hall's cloth mountains were already hung. By the window the old singer spoke to last time's window-knocker. Still needing early sleep, he'd brought his child for a brief visit, choosing the seat nearest the door. The child tugged his clothes, peering behind the mountains: the gate plainly interested them more than the song.
pairs.hanzi: 小厅的布山已经挂好，老妇站在窗边，同上回敲窗的男人说话。他今日仍要早睡，却抱着孩子来看一会儿，特地选了最靠门的位置。孩子不肯坐，揪着他衣角往布山后面望，显然那道山门比要唱的曲子更有意思。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù ná bù , lǎofù xiān wèn shuí jiào tā zìjǐ zhàn wèizhì . tǎ wéi lèngzhù , tā biàn xiào , ràng tā kàn lìngyìtóu , xiǎogūniáng zhèng zuàn zhe bù jiǎo , qiántou shǎo le gēn néng jià zhù bù de duǎn gān . tā jīnrì gāi qù zhǎo gān , búshì yòu bǎ yízuò shāndǐng zài dù chéng tóushàng .
pairs.english: As Tavi went for the cloth, the singer asked who'd told him to claim that position. He stopped short; laughing, she pointed to the little girl holding the other corner. They lacked a short supporting rod: he must find that today, not put a mountain on Du Cheng's head again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去拿布，老妇先问谁叫他自己占位置。塔维愣住，她便笑，让他看另一头，小姑娘正攥着布角，前头少了根能架住布的短杆。他今日该去找杆，不是又把一座山顶在杜澄头上。

pairs.target: xià róng shāohòu cái dào , shǒulǐ ná zhe liǎngzhāng shèng zhǐ . tā búshì lái sòngxìn de , shuō jīnrì háiyǒu yìzhuāng shì shuōwán , zuǐ zài jiǎng biàn yào mó báo , zhī xiǎng zhǎo gè dìfāng zuò . gǔshǒu gěi tā nuó le yìdiǎn dèng miàn , zìjǐ fǎn zuò dào dèng biān , dìyīshēng gǔ qiāoxiàqù chàdiǎn zhěnggè rén huádiào , háizi lìkè xiào le .
pairs.english: Xiarong came later with two scrap sheets. Not delivering mail, she said she'd finished another piece of talking today; any more would wear her mouth thin, and she only wanted a seat. The drummer shifted aside for her, nearly sliding off the bench with his first beat. The child laughed at once.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒稍后才到，手里拿着两张剩纸。她不是来送信的，说今日还有一桩事说完，嘴再讲便要磨薄，只想找个地方坐。鼓手给她挪了一点凳面，自己反坐到凳边，第一声鼓敲下去差点整个人滑掉，孩子立刻笑了。

pairs.target: qǔzi chàngqǐlái , tǎ wéi zhàn zài bù hòu , jiàn dēngguāng jiāng xiǎogūniáng de shǒuzhǐ zhào chū yìquān hóng . tā lǎo xiǎng xiān xiān , tǎ wéi bùgǎn yònglì zhuài , zhī qīngqīng pèng tā shǒubèi , děng lǎofù zhuǎntóu . chàng dào kāi shānmén shí , liǎng rén yìqǐ lā , gǔshǒu zuǐlǐ zhèhuí méiyǒu bǐng , què gùyì zuòchū gǔ zhe sāi de yàngzi .
pairs.english: The song began. Behind the cloth Tavi saw a red rim of lamplight through the girl's fingers. She kept trying to lift early; not daring to tug hard, he lightly touched the back of her hand and waited for the singer's turn. At “open the mountain gate” they pulled together. This time the drummer had no flatbread in his mouth, but deliberately puffed his cheeks.
pairs.hanzi: 曲子唱起来，塔维站在布后，见灯光将小姑娘的手指照出一圈红。她老想先掀，塔维不敢用力拽，只轻轻碰她手背，等老妇转头。唱到开山门时，两人一起拉，鼓手嘴里这回没有饼，却故意做出鼓着腮的样子。

pairs.target: shānmén kāi le , hòumiàn bìng méiyǒu shénme wēié gōngquē , zhǐshì jǐzhī dié zài yìqǐ de jiù mùxiāng , yìtiáo bù zuò de lù , lù jìntóu lì zhe gè xiāo dé wāiwāi de rén . háizi kànjiàn tā , wèn nà rén wéihé méiyǒu bízi . chànggē de rén rěn zhe xiào , xià yíjù de tiáo biàn guǎi piān le , dù chéng de wěi guǎn zhuī le bànpāi , suǒxìng yě guǎiguòqù .
pairs.english: The gate opened onto no grand palace, just stacked old crates and a cloth road ending at a crooked little carved figure. The child asked why it had no nose. Suppressing laughter, the singer bent the next phrase out of tune; Du Cheng's pipe chased it half a beat and then bent along with it.
pairs.hanzi: 山门开了，后面并没有什么巍峨宫阙，只是几只叠在一起的旧木箱，一条布做的路，路尽头立着个削得歪歪的人。孩子看见它，问那人为何没有鼻子。唱歌的人忍着笑，下一句的调便拐偏了，杜澄的苇管追了半拍，索性也拐过去。

pairs.target: sànchǎng bǐ shàng huí zǎo , chuāngwài tiānsè shàng liú zhe qiǎnlán . nàge bào háizi de nánrén xiān shuō xièxiè , dù chéng zuǐ shàng shuō zǒngsuàn búyòng gǎn wǒmen sàn , shǒulǐ què jiē zhù háizi dì lái de wāi mù rén , shuō xiàhuí tiān bízi , bié tiān tài dà , lùshang huì zhuàng shān .
pairs.english: They finished earlier, pale blue still in the sky. The father thanked them first. Du Cheng joked that at last nobody had to drive them out, while accepting the child's crooked figure: next time it would get a nose, not too large or it'd collide with mountains along the road.
pairs.hanzi: 散场比上回早，窗外天色尚留着浅蓝。那个抱孩子的男人先说谢谢，杜澄嘴上说总算不用赶我们散，手里却接住孩子递来的歪木人，说下回添鼻子，别添太大，路上会撞山。

pairs.target: xià róng liúxià bāng zhe shōu zhǐ , tǎ wéi wèn nà liǎngzhāng shèng zhǐ néngfǒu gěi zìjǐ , tā xiǎng huà mén hòu nàtiáo lù . tā shuō kě suàn yǒurén bù ná zhǐ lái gǎi shíchén , dìgěi tā yǐhòu yòu shēnshǒu tǎo huílái yìjiǎo , gěi zìjǐ huà le nà zhǐyǒu bízi hái méi cháng chūlái de mù rén . liǎng rén huà dé dōu bú xiàng , biàn gè shuō duìfāng gèng xiàng .
pairs.english: Xiarong stayed to gather paper. Tavi asked for her two scraps to draw the road behind the gate. Finally someone wasn't using paper to change appointments, she said, then reclaimed a corner to draw the figure whose nose hadn't grown yet. Neither drawing resembled it; each said the other's did more.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒留下帮着收纸，塔维问那两张剩纸能否给自己，他想画门后那条路。她说可算有人不拿纸来改时辰，递给他以后又伸手讨回来一角，给自己画了那只有鼻子还没长出来的木人。两人画得都不像，便各说对方更像。

pairs.target: huíqù shí , dù chéng cóng xiùlǐ mō chū yíyè jiālǐ de xìn , gěi tāmen kàn nǚér huà de wěi guǎn . tú shàng duō le yígè kǒng , pángbiān wèn cóng nǎbiān chuī , tā niáng yòu tiān yíjù , biéjiào dé tóng nǐ dāngnián yíyàng , bǎ línjūjiā de gǒu dōu yǐnlái . dù chéng shuō jiālǐ nàtiáo gǒu běnlái jiù ài jiào , xià róng wèn tā wěi guǎn jiào bu jiào , tā biàn jiāng xìn shōuhuí , shuō jīnwǎn bú jiào rén chuī le .
pairs.english: On the way back Du Cheng showed a page from home: his daughter's drawing of a reed pipe had one extra hole, with a question about which end to blow into. Her mother added: don't teach her like you used to play, calling every neighbor's dog over. Du Cheng said their dog always barked anyway. When Xiarong asked if his pipe barked too, he put the letter away: no teaching tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 回去时，杜澄从袖里摸出一页家里的信，给他们看女儿画的苇管。图上多了一个孔，旁边问从哪边吹，她娘又添一句，别教得同你当年一样，把邻居家的狗都引来。杜澄说家里那条狗本来就爱叫，夏绒问他苇管叫不叫，他便将信收回，说今晚不教人吹了。

pairs.target: zǒu le jǐbù , dù chéng zìjǐ yòu xiào qǐlái . tǎ wéi dītóu kàn gāng huà de lù , hēixiàn cóng mùxiāng zhījiān wāi chūqù , tā méiyǒu cā , pà cā le biàn bú jìde jīnwǎn jiūjìng shì zěnyàng xiào guò de .
pairs.english: A few steps later Du Cheng laughed himself. Tavi looked at the road he'd just drawn, its black line wandering out among crates. He didn't erase it, fearing he would lose the memory of how they had laughed tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 走了几步，杜澄自己又笑起来。塔维低头看刚画的路，黑线从木箱之间歪出去，他没有擦，怕擦了便不记得今晚究竟是怎样笑过的。
